page_title: RSO 3-4 VAL | Real Sociedad v Valencia 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' 3 - 4 Javi Guerra (Valencia) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alex Remiro with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:4.
90+3' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.

89' 3 - 3 The ball was swung into the box by Andre Almeida from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Guido Rodriguez (Valencia), who planted a long-range header inside the right post to make the score 3:3.
89' It will be a corner kick for Valencia.
88' The game has begun to heat up. Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
88' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
86' It must be a yellow card. It is. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

85' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
84' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) replacing Aritz Elustondo.
83' The substitution is prepared. Andre Almeida (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Unai Nunez.
80' The attendance is 29466.
79' That will be all from Orri Oskarsson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad).
76' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) has a goal ruled out for offside!
75' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
74' Here comes a substitution. Pepelu (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Diego Lopez.
74' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Luis Rioja and he is replaced by Largie Ramazani (Valencia).
73' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Filip Ugrinic is replaced by Thierry Rendall (Valencia).
73' Hugo Duro goes off the pitch and Umar Sadiq (Valencia) comes on.

70' Eray Comert (Valencia) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off! Real Sociedad have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
68' Real Sociedad control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
66' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
65' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

63' 3 - 2 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal displays great vision and sends a pass to Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top right corner. The score is 3:2.

62' Diego Lopez (Valencia) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
60' 2 - 2 This is definitely not what Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 2:2.
57' A substitution has been made. Brais Mendez goes off and Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) comes on.
57' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan will be replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
57' Substitution. Aihen Munoz walks off the pitch and Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
57' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
54' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Flag up against Hugo Duro (Valencia). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
48' Dangerous play by Unai Nunez (Valencia). Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Iosu Galech blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Luis Rioja (Valencia) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

42' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
39' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.
38' Real Sociedad couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) leaped high and intercepted the cross. Real Sociedad win a corner.
37' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Orri Oskarsson, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

35' Close! Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.

34' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
33' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
28' Arsen Zakharyan is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
26' Great teamplay by Real Sociedad as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

24' Javi Guerra (Valencia) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.

22' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Hugo Duro (Valencia) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Eray Comert. The score is now 1:2.
20' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
15' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
13' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Iosu Galech stops the game and makes a call.
8' 1 - 1 Goal! Diego Lopez tees up Javi Guerra (Valencia) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:1.
7' A superb shot by Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.

6' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Free kick. Valencia will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Aritz Elustondo plays it to Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Stole Dimitrievski. 1:0.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
Iosu Galech got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
